newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers stable in thin talk.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers stable in thin talk.

text.p: The Singapore bunker market was quiet on Monday in thin talk after the weekend and before a domestic holiday on Wednesday, traders said.
"Enquiries are very few so far," said one trader. Some suppliers lowered their offers slightly to woo shipowners while most maintained recent firm levels amid crude gains and cargo strength.

The 380-cst was quoted at $100/$103 and the 180-cst was at around $107/$109. Suppliers said they would make a loss to offer the 380-cst grade at below $100. MDO and gas oil were at $190/$193 and $200/$205 respectively. -- Singapore Newsroom (65 8703571)
